summary: Isolate queue LLM transport tests from operator configuration

delivery.outcome: Publish and independently merge hermetic queue LLM regressions which cannot use operator model configuration, with an explicit positive central-transport test.

validation.evidence: The previously failing transport cases pass without live requests; a configured central route preserves messages, timeout, model and usage.
